device.description: The block device path to partition (e.g., /dev/sda, /dev/nvme0n1).

label_type.description: The disklabel type to create (e.g., gpt, msdos, aix, amiga, bsd, dvh, loop, mac, pc98, sun).

unit.description: The unit for displaying locations and sizes (e.g., s, B, kB, MB, KiB, MiB, GB, GiB, TB, TiB, %, cyl, chs, compact).

partitions.description: A list of partition definitions to be created on the device. Items define each partition's attributes.

partitions.items.description: Flat map of attributes for a single partition item in the partitions list.

partitions.items.name.description: The name of the partition. Required for GPT, optional for msdos.

partitions.items.part_type.description: The partition type (primary, logical, extended). Only applicable for msdos and dvh labels.

partitions.items.start.description: The start position of the partition. Interpreted based on the 'unit' setting.

partitions.items.end.description: The end position of the partition. Interpreted based on the 'unit' setting.

partitions.items.fs_type.description: The filesystem type metadata for the partition (e.g., ext4, xfs, fat32, linux-swap). Optional.

partitions.items.flag.description: The flag to set on the partition (e.g., boot, esp, bios_grub). Optional.
